purpose: Reviewed inventory of every runtime clock and its phase ownership, recorded by issue #188 before any convergence changes scheduling. It is a description of the code as it stands, not a target.
validation_contract: every clock names a real source file and function that exist in the workspace
every clock states its cadence source, its diff source and whether it is production or diagnostic
no clock claims to deliver packets or await while holding a map guard
each clock's resolution guard names the mechanism that stops a second owner resolving the same transition
each regression anchor names a test function that exists

owns: world-level timers and the configured periodic work C++ drives from World::Update
clocks.resolution_guard: single spawned task; no second owner drives world-level timers

clocks.diff_source: measured elapsed wall clock, clamped to u32, zero-diff ticks skipped
clocks.delivery_note: recipients and packets are collected inside the guarded block and delivered after the map lock is released
clocks.resolution_guard: canonical Map::Update dispatches no AI/combat side effects, so it cannot double-resolve a legacy creature transition

clocks.cpp_anchor: Map::Update creature frame: Unit -> threat -> AI -> melee
clocks.diff_source: measured elapsed wall clock, propagated once into creature logical elapsed time; the constant interval was a real defect corrected by M2.3 and the per-creature wall-clock epoch was retired by #371
clocks.delivery_note: each run_legacy_creature_*_and_deliver_once_like_cpp bridge collects outcomes under the lock and delivers once after release
clocks.resolution_guard: RuntimeTickOwner: the loop only resolves when the owner is GlobalLegacy, and session ticks read the same shared owner and skip

owns: ready-check expiry for every active group
clocks.delivery_note: tick_all_group_ready_checks_like_cpp returns events; fanout happens outside any Group or Map guard
clocks.resolution_guard: single spawned task; the Group owner exposes one tick entry point
single spawned task; touches no map or creature state
single spawned task; touches no gameplay state

clocks.cpp_anchor: none: C++ has no session-driven creature frame
clocks.cadence: driven by the owning session task
clocks.resolution_guard: RuntimeTickOwner::Session; production startup sets GlobalLegacy so this path is inert unless the diagnostic config override selects it

tick_owner.production_default_mechanism: RustyCore.LegacyCreatureGlobalRuntime is read as u8 and defaults to enabled when absent (unwrap_or(true)); app startup then calls set_tick_owner(GlobalLegacy)
tick_owner.note: The constructed default and the production default deliberately differ: MapManager::new is used by tests and by the diagnostic path, while production always overrides it at startup. Setting the config key to 0 restores the session-owned diagnostic path.
